facts.value: UL’s degree in Industrial Biochemistry provides students with brilliant hands-on laboratory experience, especially in Years 1–3. In Year 4, each student gets the opportunity to complete an individual research project and gets to choose from a wide range of interesting elective modules. This is a great opportunity to take ownership of your degree and it allows everyone to learn about topics that interest them most.
Students have a broad range of career paths available to them after graduation, including the opportunity to pursue postgraduate studies.
I was impressed by the wide variety of modules.
In Year 4, each student gets the opportunity to complete an individual research project.
I completed my eight-month Co-op placement in Regeneron’s Industrial Operations and Product Supply (IOPS) site in Limerick.
I was an intern in the Formulation and Filling team in the Large-Scale manufacturing department.
I had the opportunity to develop soft skills such as teamwork, communication, and troubleshooting.
Students have a broad range of career paths available to them after graduation.
I am currently an Irish Research Council-funded Ph.D. student at the Bernal Institute, in UL.
